method: Full .08 collars are exact extrusion of the original section; interlocking stone construction transitions into that section by x=.42. Actual material mixes to constant blue at collar_weight=1. Cap and surfaces evaluate same local-y analytic normal, then normalize, rotate as NORMAL by object root, and normalize again. Normal and color have no x/z dependence on collars, including opaque caps. Cap geometric outward normals remain opposing. Formula and actual node graph retained. Samples evaluate the exact shader formula, actual mesh rings and actual frozen transforms; images test visibility beyond this field proof.
